verdict.rationale: Several SKILL.md files carry trigger-style descriptions, e.g. the TDD skill's "Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions 'red-green-refactor'…" and grilling's "Use when the user wants to stress-test their thinking", which suggests they are written for model-driven activation. However, the documented usage path is "type a slash command", and a dedicated skill exists just to work out which skill fits the situation, so automatic context-based triggering is implied rather than stated. missing for 10: explicit documentation that skills auto-activate from task context, trigger descriptions shown across the full skill set, hands-on evidence that the agent picks the right skill without manual invocation.
